title: Class-II source, translated model, universal Q, finite jet forest, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. The translation and universal-Q continuations prove the flexible epsilon_6<gamma/6 range, exact finite-cutoff translation/frame/Cartan identities, deterministic-shift expectation positivity, and the universal centered derivative-square tensor in every finite Lp(Omega;H^(-1-kappa)) with deterministic H2 Cameron-Martin continuity. Literal full XQ/XXQ products miss the advertised improved model regularities, while a cone-localized raw nested subdiagram has fixed negative logarithmically accumulating magnitude without a proved total-tree coefficient. The new finite-cutoff forest subproof exactly classifies the 2, 4+2, 5+2, and 3+0 Wiener contractions for complete non-aliased sharp-cube products. Under the entrywise-even six-real A1 covariance, all complete-sector value-derivative and double-cross corrections cancel, and raw XXQ retains only the finite tensor Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda. This does not close balanced coefficient-jet continuum convergence, rational-B/A7 reconstruction, the translated-current model lift, or the umbrella one-use theorem.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-UNIVERSAL-Q-AND-FINITE-FOREST-REDUCTIONS-WITH-EXECUTED-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact non-aliased Fourier products, common entrywise-real-even finite sharp regulators, covariance-matched A7 Wick subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The finite forest theorem requires a complete low/resonant/high partition over the full output support, no intermediate projection, and at most one common root projection. Its sparse convolution and Hermite fixtures are exact finite-cutoff checks, not continuum proofs. Balanced top-chaos jet convergence, individual resonant reconstruction, adapted random translation control, rational-B/A7 identity, the parent model lift, and the umbrella one-use gate remain open.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 Fierz, source, factor-four, one-use/Nelson, scalar-loop, nonfrozen determinant, potential, translation/frame, Cartan, expectation, universal-Q, or raw-jet assertion remains a falsifier. The finite forest continuation is falsified by a wrong 2/4+2/5+2/3+0 contraction count, incomplete sharp-cube pair or nested partition, failure of either exact sparse parenthesisation to reconstruct the full triple convolution, nonzero complete entrywise mixed covariance or double-cross coefficient under the pinned even A1 law, loss of the asymmetric-regulator failure control, omission of the finite tensor Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda, source/PDF hash mismatch, failed five-page visual QA, any failure in the 82-assertion aggregate, or a release-gate failure.

reproduction.expected: Primary 34/34, non-importing independent 31/31, integrated 17/17, and aggregate 82/82 pass; A13-CLASSII-COEFFICIENT-JET-FOREST-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: The finite forest theorem proves zero net value-derivative and double-cross correction only for complete covariance-matched non-aliased monomials under the entrywise-even A1 law. It does not license deletion of resonant-only correctors, improve the literal full-product regularity, or prove continuum balanced-jet convergence. The finite tensor Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda must be retained. This claim does not complete rational-B/A7 reconstruction, control random or adapted translations, prove the signed form bound, controlled-shell estimate, equivalent q=10/9 Nelson moment, A11/A7 closure, interacting measure, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7.
next_action: Continue A13-CLASSII-COEFFICIENT-JET-RENORMALISATION-CLASSIFICATION as a subproof, not a new claim. Construct balanced or base-point-increment P3 and P4 jets, prove coupled-cutoff convergence in every finite probability moment at H^(alpha-1-kappa) and H^(2alpha-1-kappa), retain the finite Sigma Q conversion, and prove the exact rational-B translated-current reconstruction in the A7 covariance-normal scheme. Only after that identity closes may the strict-past signed Q/current/positive-square/Cartan-curvature one-use bound be attempted.
